extracted.name: Taco Mix with Black Beans
extracted.description: This simple mixture of beef, black beans, salsa, and taco seasoning can be used as a filling in a variety of Mexican-style dishes.
ingredient_lines: 1 (19 ounce) can black beans, rinsed and drained
instruction_lines: Heat a large skillet over medium heat. Add beef; cook and stir until browned and crumbly, 5 to 7 minutes.
Stir in black beans, salsa, water, and taco seasoning; cook, stirring frequently, until heated through, 5 to 7 minutes.
